response: Introducing Saved Views, a new way to work faster in your project management workspace. Starting today, you can save any filtered, sorted, or grouped list as a custom view and return to it instantly, without rebuilding it every time. Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, so every team on a paid subscription gets access right away. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, client, or workflow stage—whatever fits how you actually work. Views aren't just for you: they can be shared with your team, so everyone sees the same filters, sorting, and layout without recreating them from scratch. This makes onboarding new teammates easier and keeps reporting consistent across projects. Whether you're tracking sprint progress, monitoring overdue tasks, or building a dashboard for stakeholders, Saved Views helps your whole team stay aligned on what matters most. We think you'll find it a simple addition with a real impact on daily productivity. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
